title: rostraria cristata subsp. subcapitata
intro: Rostraria cristata subsp. subcapitata, commonly known as the Mediterranean club grass or club grass, is a plant species within the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rostraria cristata subsp. subcapitata include stimulating coughing to aid in the expulsion of mucus, relieving bronchial spasms, and soothing irritated mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
